title: Contiki-NG + Zephyr: UDP echo over 6LoWPAN
description: A Contiki-NG node (examples/interop/echo-zephyr) sends UDP datagrams of 16 to 640 bytes to Zephyr's stock echo_server sample and checks that the same bytes come back; from 128 bytes up they are 6LoWPAN-fragmented both ways. No routing protocol: the Contiki-NG node takes Zephyr's client address 2001:db8::2 and finds the server 2001:db8::1 with IPv6 Neighbor Discovery.
